title: THE PESTEST BACK
description: Don't you want the grass to be an awesome homage to george allen and unwin??
body:
Replaces the top grass block with a cool homage to George Allen and Unwin

This pack replaces the grass_top texture with a pixelized rendition of the george allen and unwin logo used on the cover art of The hobbit!

This is for all you george allen and unwin-heads who want your minecraft to have a cool homage to their favorite publishing company!!

Here is an example of how it looks in-game:

![https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/bFEz4kua/images/070a959d0ee399163b999a48f96bfbd4a9b6aff4.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/bFEz4kua/images/070a959d0ee399163b999a48f96bfbd4a9b6aff4.png)
